name: ngram-type
title: Ngram Type
description: Build touch-typing reflexes with guided n-gram drills: bigrams to the most common English words, accuracy-first, with a Focus bank for your mistakes.
author: imbrian

commands.name: practice
commands.title: Practice Ngrams
commands.description: Practice guided n-gram typing drills, from bigrams to common English words and optional sentences

scripts.build:data: node scripts/build-english-core.mjs && node scripts/generate-english-phrases.mjs && node scripts/build-english-phrases.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check:data && tsc --outDir test-dist --declaration false --sourceMap false && node --test test-dist/test/*.test.js

preferences.name: defaultMode
preferences.title: Default Mode
preferences.description: Where you start on first launch, before any progress is saved. Later you can switch anytime from the Action Panel.

preferences.name: soundEnabled
preferences.title: Sound Effects
preferences.label: Enable typing sounds on first launch
preferences.description: Initial sound setting on first launch. Toggle anytime with ⌘⇧M.

preferences.name: defaultMinWPM
preferences.title: Default WPM Goal
preferences.description: WPM goal for free practice when you haven't set your own goal in Practice Settings. Guided lessons use their own goals. Applies immediately.
